notes.title: Thank You All Hold Your King Fans!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692468/7fb02d3d361db135f4dd1bd5c592f4f1b00afadf.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to share that Hold Your King has officially passed 1000 wishlists on Steam! 👑

This means the kingdom is growing strong, and more brave players are getting ready to carry the king or, well... drop him occasionally. 😅

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for the support so far.

We're just getting started, and your enthusiasm means the world to us.

👉 If you haven’t already, add Hold Your King to your wishlist to be notified the moment we launch!

Big things are coming soon — stay tuned![/p]
